ios.desc:
Power your financial future on Robinhood. Join over 28 million people using Robinhood to trade crypto, stocks, ETFs, options, predictions markets and save for retirement — all in one app.

TRADING
- Commission-free trading on stocks, ETFs, & options. Other fees may apply.
- Advanced trading tools: Robinhood Legend desktop charting, smart trend tools, & real-time AI market insights.
- Flexible day trading: fast, powerful execution built for active strategies.
- Competitive margin rates: grow your buying power with low, industry-leading borrowing rates.

RETIREMENT & MANAGED PORTFOLIOS
- Managed portfolios: professionally managed portfolios tailored to your financial goals with Robinhood Strategies.
- IRA Match: supercharge your retirement savings with extra match contributions on eligible deposits.

ROBINHOOD GOLD ($5/month, $50/annual)
- Earn 3.6% APY on eligible uninvested cash (no cap)¹.
- Get Instant Deposits up to $50,000².
- First $1K of margin investing interest free (if eligible)³.

PREDICTION MARKETS
- Turn your insights into trades on a regulated exchange.
- Trade event contracts in the Robinhood Prediction Markets Hub featuring sports, politics, economics, & culture.

ROBINHOOD CRYPTO
- 80+ crypto assets available. Trade BTC, ETH, DOGE & more.
- Transfer crypto with zero deposit or withdrawal fees.

Investing is risky, consider investment objectives & risks carefully before investing.
¹ The High-Yield Cash Program is an added feature to your Robinhood Financial LLC brokerage account. The rate may change at any time. Review more details about how the High-Yield Cash Program works in the High-Yield Cash Program Agreement.

² Bigger Instant Deposits are only available if your Instant Deposits status is in good standing. Does not apply to IRAs or managed accounts.

³ Not all investors will be eligible to trade on Margin. Margin investing involves the risk of greater investment losses. Additional interest charges may apply depending on the amount of margin used. Rates subject to change.

View Robinhood Financial's fee schedule at rbnhd.co/fees
Trading and owning digital assets involves significant risk, including the risk of substantial loss. Cryptocurrency services are offered through an account with Robinhood Crypto, LLC (NMLS ID 1702840). Robinhood Crypto is licensed to engage in virtual currency business activity by the New York State Department of Financial Services. Cryptocurrency held through Robinhood Crypto is not FDIC insured or SIPC protect
